summary: Aurora Cannabis filed a 6-K attaching an October 6, 2026 news release responding to Curaleaf's revised hostile take-over bid for all Aurora shares. Curaleaf now offers implied US$5.00 per share: 0.4013 Curaleaf subordinate voting shares plus US$1.00 cash, with the bid extended to at least December 4, 2026. Aurora's Special Committee, advised by Kingsdale Advisors, is commencing review and urges shareholders to take no action pending a formal Board recommendation and Directors' Circular. Watch for the Board's recommendation, valuation defense, and any regulatory or financing conditions; the wide gap between bid expiry and recommendation timing creates event-driven optionality and deal-completion risk.
